description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which implements a retry mechanism for failed AWS service requests. It includes methods for creating deciders, handling retry logic, and exponential backoff delays.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that manages retry logic for AWS SDK requests, supporting exponential backoff and configurable retry conditions.

methods.name: createDefaultDecider
methods.description: Creates a default function to decide if an AWS request should be retried based on status codes, error codes, and other conditions.

methods.name: isRetryable
methods.description: Determines if a request or error is retryable based on response result or exception, considering custom error and status codes.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Calculates an exponential backoff delay with jitter for retries.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method that executes the retry logic, managing retries, delays, and handling success or failure responses.
